title: How to build an estate inventory list template on Mac for estate administrators
metaTitle: Estate inventory list template for Mac: guide for administrators
description: Learn to build an efficient estate inventory list template on your Mac to track assets and liabilities with ease, reducing administrative overhead.
intro: Creating a reliable estate inventory list template on your Mac is the first step toward managing complex probate cases with precision. You need a structured approach to track every asset and liability, ensuring nothing is missed during the settlement process.
tldr: Build your inventory template in Excel for maximum flexibility and calculation power.
Use your Mac to centralize documentation, reducing the time spent on manual data entry.
Lazur helps you navigate complex software interfaces, allowing you to focus on the legal nuances rather than the tools.
Maintain high standards for data privacy by following your firm's specific protocols for handling sensitive client information.

blocks.text: Why you need a custom estate inventory list template

Settling an estate involves hundreds of data points. From bank accounts and real estate to personal property and debts, the complexity grows quickly. A standardized estate inventory list template allows you to categorize assets consistently across every file you manage. It saves you from building a new spreadsheet from scratch every time a new case arrives on your desk.

When you use Excel on your Mac, you can leverage advanced formulas to sum totals automatically. This reduces the risk of human error in your financial reporting. If you are working on a Mac, you likely value the speed of keyboard shortcuts. For example, using ⌘ + 1 opens the Format Cells dialog, where you can quickly set your currency and date formats for your inventory columns.

items: Asset Category: Clearly label items as Real Estate, Financial Accounts, or Personal Property.
Description: Include specific details like account numbers, property addresses, or serial numbers.
Valuation Date: Record the exact date the asset value was determined for probate accuracy.
Current Value: Keep a column for the fair market value at the time of death.
Status: Use a dropdown menu to track if the asset is appraised, sold, or distributed.

blocks.text: Consistency is your best defense against errors. If you use a dropdown menu in Excel, you ensure that every team member enters data the same way. Select your Status column, go to Data > Data Validation, and choose List to create your options. This keeps your data clean for later analysis.
Managing administrative burdens on your Mac

The administrative tax on estate administrators is high. You spend hours on email, phone calls, and documentation. Much of this time is lost to context switching between your email client and your asset tracking spreadsheets. By using a centralized template, you can quickly verify information without digging through dozens of separate files.

When you need to update your inventory based on an incoming email, keep your spreadsheet open in one half of your screen and your mail client in the other. If you are using Split View on macOS, you can drag your window to the top left corner of the screen and select the other app to fill the remaining space. This visual alignment helps you process data faster.

Always follow your firm's specific rules regarding client data. Never store sensitive personal identification numbers in unencrypted files. If you are using Excel, ensure your workbook is password protected. Lazur does not store your data, but you must remain vigilant about where you save your local files.
blocks.title: Protecting client confidentiality

blocks.text: If you need to password protect a file, go to File > Passwords in Excel. Set a robust password that you store in a secure manager. Never use weak passwords for estate files. Security is not just a policy; it is a daily habit.
Using Lazur to speed up your workflow

Lazur acts as a bridge between your intent and your Mac interface. If you are searching for a specific menu item in a complex app like Acrobat Pro or Excel, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask where it is. Lazur will circle the button on your screen. This saves you from hunting through menus when you are under a deadline.

When you need to draft a quick update to a beneficiary, hold fn to dictate your notes. You can speak clearly and let Lazur handle the formatting. This is useful when you have a stack of physical documents to review and your hands are occupied. It keeps your eyes on the documents instead of the keyboard.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur to automate data entry?
faq.answer: Lazur does not click buttons or edit files for you. It helps you navigate your apps faster and dictates text, but you retain full control over your data entry.

faq.question: Is my data safe when using Lazur?
faq.answer: Lazur only looks at your screen or listens when you hold the shortcut. The data is not stored or used to train AI models. You should always follow your employer's rules for data privacy.

faq.question: What software should I use for estate inventory?
faq.answer: Many administrators use Excel for its calculation power and flexibility. Some also use specialized probate software, but a well-designed Excel template remains a standard tool for asset tracking.
